name: arya-sub-bass
notes: Audition variant of the user-approved custom-2, for stock pads. Deeper rumble rather than more kick: about 2-2.5 dB more at 20-40 Hz and about 2 dB less at 100 Hz. Keeps all midrange/treble filters unchanged. Raw device Q. All five arya audition presets use -11.5 dB preamp, 1.5 dB below custom-2; equal preamp is not perceptual loudness matching. Modeled headroom only; not acoustically verified or auditioned. Strong sub-bass boost: start quietly and do not turn up to chase physical impact.
